subject.title: Beta blocker: codex - app-server binding can exceed plugin-state limit

question: Should a corrected bounded-fingerprint fix be required before the next beta release?
rationale: The defect and repair boundary are established, but the protected beta-blocker designation makes release inclusion an explicit maintainer decision.

options.title: Require corrected fix
options.body: Resolve the linked PR's typecheck blocker and land the bounded-fingerprint repair before cutting the next beta.

options.title: Defer and remove blocker
options.body: Defer only if maintainers remove the beta-blocker designation and explicitly accept the known plugin-heavy Codex failure for that beta.

recommendation.title: Require corrected fix
recommendation.body: Resolve the linked PR's typecheck blocker and land the bounded-fingerprint repair before cutting the next beta.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest feature-history owner for the Codex app-server lifecycle and the most likely owner of the beta inclusion decision among identified candidates.
